chapterInfo.content:
7
Wɔkum Israelfoɔ wɔ Ai. Wɔkum Akan
1Na Israelfoɔ no too ahyiradeɛ no ho mmara, na Sera ba Sabdi ba Karmi ba Akan a ɔfiri Yuda abusuakuo mu no faa ahyiradeɛ no bi, na AWURADE bo fuu Israelfoɔ no. 2Na Yosua somaa mmarima bi firi Yeriko kɔɔ Ai a ɛwɔ Bet-awen ho, Betel apueeɛ, na ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Monkɔ nkɔsra asase no. Na mmarima no kɔ kɔsraa Ai. 3Na wɔsane baa Yosua nkyɛn bɛka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Mma ɔman no nyinaa mmforo nnkɔ; na mmarima bɛyɛ mpennu anaa mpensa nkɔbɔ Ai, nha ɔman no nyinaa mma wɔnnkɔ hɔ, na wɔsua. 4Na ɔman no mu bɛyɛ mpensa foro kɔɔ hɔ, nanso wɔdwane firii Ai mmarima no anim. 5Na Ai mmarima no kunkumm wɔn mu nnipa bɛyɛ aduasa nsia, na wɔtaa wɔn Ai kuro pono no akyi de kɔɔ Sebarim, na wɔbobɔɔ wɔn asianee no mu. Na ɔman no akoma tui, na ɛyɛɛ sɛ nsuo.
6Na Yosua sunsuanee ne ntadeɛ mu, na ɔde n’anim butuu fam, AWURADE adaka no anim de kɔsii anwummerɛ, ɔno ne Israel mpanimfoɔ, na wɔde dɔteɛ guguu wɔn atifi. 7Na Yosua kaa sɛ: AWURADE Nyankopɔn, adɛn nti na wode ɔman yi twaa Yordan sɛ wode yɛn rebɛhyɛ Amorifoɔ nsa na wɔasɛe yɛn? Yɛnim a, anka yɛpene tenaa Yordan agya hɔ ara. 8Wo kyɛw nie, AWURADE, sɛ Israel adane wɔn akyi akyerɛ wɔn atamfoɔ yi, ɛdeɛn na menka? 9#Eks 32.12 Na Kanaanfoɔ ne asase yi sofoɔ nyinaa bɛte, na wɔabɛtwa yɛn ho ahyia, na wɔatwa yɛn din afiri asase so: Na ɛdeɛn na wobɛyɛ ama wo din kɛseɛ no?
10Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Yosua sɛ: Sɔre ɛ, adɛn nti na wode w’anim abutu fam seyie? 11Israel ayɛ bɔne, wɔato m’apam a mehyɛɛ wɔn ho mmara no nso, na wɔafa ahyiradeɛ no bi nso, na wɔabɔ korɔno nso, na wɔasi so nso, na wɔde asie wɔn adeɛ mu nso. 12Na Israelfoɔ no rentumi nnyina wɔn atamfoɔ anim, wɔn akyiri na wɔbɛdane akyerɛ wɔn atamfoɔ, ɛfiri sɛ wɔayɛ ahyiradeɛ. Merenkɔ so menni mo akyi, gye sɛ moyi ahyiradeɛ no hɔ firi mo mu. 13#Yos 3.5 Sɔre te ɔman no ho na ka sɛ: Monyɛ mo ho kronkron nsie ɔkyena; na sɛ AWURADE, Israel Nyankopɔn no seɛ nie: Ahyiradeɛ wɔ wo mu, Israel! Worentumi nnyina w’atamfo anim kɔsi sɛ mobɛyi ahyiradeɛ no afiri mo mu. 14Enti anɔpa, wɔmfa mo mpinkyɛ mmusuakuo mmusuakuo. Na abusuakuo a AWURADE bɛkyerɛ no ntwe mpini mmusua mmusua, na abusua a AWURADE bɛkyerɛ no ntwe mpini afie, na efie a AWURADE bɛkyerɛ no mu mmarima ntwe mpini mmaako mmaako. 15Na deɛ wɔbɛkye no ahyiradeɛ no ho no, wɔmfa ogya nhye no ne deɛ ɔwɔ nyinaa, sɛ wato AWURADE ntam, na wayɛ nkwaseadeɛ Israel mu.
16 # 1 Sa 10.20-21; 14.41-42 Ɛnna Yosua sɔree anɔpahema, na ɔde Israel pinkyɛe abusuakuo abusuakuo. Na wɔkyeree Yuda abusuakuo. 17#Num 26.20 Na ɔde Yuda mmusua pinkyɛe, na wɔkyeree Serafoɔ abusua. Na ɔde Serafoɔ abusua mu mmarima pinkyɛe mmaako mmaako, na wɔkyeree Sabdi. 18Na ɔde ne fie mmarima pinkyɛe mmaako mmaako, na wɔkyeree Sera ba Sabdi ba Karmi ba Akan a ɔfiri Yuda abusuakuo mu. 19Na Yosua ka kyerɛɛ Akan sɛ: Me ba, fa animuonyam ma AWURADE, Israel Nyankopɔn, na di no ni, na ka kyerɛ me ɛ: Ɛdeɛn na woyɛeɛ? Nsi me so. 20Na Akan buaa Yosua sɛ: Nokorɛ, me na mayɛ AWURADE, Israel Nyankopɔn no, bɔne, na sɛɛ ne sɛɛ na meyɛeɛ. 21Mehunuu asadeɛ no mu Sinear ngusoɔ fɛfɛ bi ne dwetɛ nnwetɛbena ahanu ne sika dame baako a ano si nnwetɛbena aduonum, na m’ani beree, na mefae; na hwɛ, ɛhyɛ fam me ntomadan mu, na dwetɛ no wɔ aseɛ.
22Ɛnna Yosua somaa abɔfoɔ, na wɔde mmirika kɔɔ ntomadan no mu, na hwɛ, na ɛhyɛ ne ntomadan no mu, na dwetɛ no hyɛ aseɛ. 23Na wɔyi firii ntomadan no mu de brɛɛ Yosua ne Israelfoɔ no nyinaa, na wɔde bɛguu AWURADE anim. 24Ɛnna Yosua faa Sera ba Akan, ne dwetɛ ne ngusoɔ ne sika dame no, ne ne mmammarima ne ne mmammaa, ne n’anantwie ne ne mfunumu ne ne nnwan, ne ne ntomadan ne deɛ ɔwɔ nyinaa, na Israel nyinaa ka ne ho, na wɔde wɔn foro kɔɔ Akor bonhwa mu. 25Na Yosua kaa sɛ: Adɛn na woaha yɛn saa yi? AWURADE bɛha wo nnɛ da yi. Na Israel nyinaa sii no aboɔ, na wɔde ogya hyee wɔn, na wɔde aboɔ guu wɔn so. 26#Yes 65.10; Hos 2.15 Na wɔhɔree ne so abosie kɛseɛ a ɛwɔ hɔ de bɛsi nnɛ yi. Na AWURADE dane firii n’abufuhyeɛ no ho. Ɛno nti wɔfrɛ hɔ sɛ Akor#7.26 Asekyerɛ ne: Ɔhaw mmusuo. bonhwa de bɛsi nnɛ yi.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
